_comment: sim-robust-esdf-boot-gate-v1 bounded GPU proof. Purpose: prove the opt-in HOST key 'esdf_boot_ack_grace_s' NAMES a never-acknowledged nvblox ESDF incorporation at BOOT, on the sim clock, BEFORE the first arm motion streams -- instead of the opaque mid-stage controller invariant trip (meshuris1: CONTROLLER_INVARIANT_TRIP phase=observe now=39 collision_dt=40.0, collision_time stuck at the -1 not-ready sentinel from tick 1 -> HOST_FAULT_ESTOP 'stale collision world' -> arm heartbeat lost ~40 s in). Merge 'esdf_boot_ack_grace_s' into the mission HOST config block (restock_manipulation/ros_host_config.json, read by scripts/twin/restock_manipulation/ros_host.py; config_preflight registers it HOST). The integration lane (twin-robot-in-store-boot-v1) holds the GPU and schedules both runs through /tmp/aile-gpu.lock, never forced, never touching the whispr service; do NOT edit the ~/datasets runtime configs from a worker PR -- this fragment is the hand-off.
_esdf_boot_ack_grace_s_note: SIM seconds (sensors.simulation_time, render-pacing-safe -- NOT wall). Measured from the first controller step of an operation. The gate HOLDs the op (streams NO arm motion, does not advance the phase) until the first valid incorporation ack (the mirrored station collision_time leaving the -1 not-ready sentinel for a real integration stamp >= 0); if the grace elapses with the stamp still stuck it FAILS FAST with 'nvblox ESDF incorporation never acknowledged within <N>s sim boot grace (collision_time stuck at -1.000 ...): likely nvblox not incorporating (masked-depth feed or mapper) or a stale/uncommissioned station baseline -- failing fast before the first arm motion instead of the mid-stage collision_dt invariant'. Once a valid ack has arrived the gate disarms permanently and the existing collision_dt freshness invariant is the sole owner (its band is untouched). Absent / <= 0 => gate OFF => byte-identical. A healthy parked station publishes a fresh collision_time within ~1 s of the op, so 15 s is comfortably above a legitimate boot incorporation.

_run_A_stale_baseline._setup: Deliberately REUSE the retained stale cc-bench1 commission baseline (no re-commission), the exact meshuris1 setup (head ccc479e or later), with esdf_boot_ack_grace_s=15.0 in the HOST config.
_run_A_stale_baseline._pass_criteria: PASS = the console shows ESDF_BOOT_GATE_HOLD lines at phase=observe while collision_time stays -1.000, then the named boot fault 'nvblox ESDF incorporation never acknowledged within ~15.0s sim boot grace ...' fires BEFORE any arm motion (no approach/reach move streamed), and there is NO 'CONTROLLER_INVARIANT_TRIP ... collision_dt=40.0' and NO 40 s invariant trip. FAIL = the opaque collision_dt invariant trips, or any arm motion streams before the gate fires, or the run proceeds.

_run_B_fresh_commission._setup: FRESH-commission the station (the meshuris0 setup), with esdf_boot_ack_grace_s=15.0 in the HOST config.
_run_B_fresh_commission._pass_criteria: PASS = UNCHANGED completion -- transfer + verify reach status succeeded, the gate is SILENT (it disarms on the first valid incorporation ack, no ESDF_BOOT_GATE_HOLD/TRIP lines), and the collision_dt invariant owns freshness exactly as today. This proves the key does not perturb a healthy run.

_activation_check: At host boot the HOST_EFFECTIVE_CONFIG console line reports 'esdf_boot_ack_grace_s': 15.0 (0.0 would mean the gate is off -- the run-277 wrong-config-file trap); config_preflight --require esdf_boot_ack_grace_s asserts it is present in the HOST config.
_cpu_proof: scripts/twin/tests/test_sim_robust_esdf_boot_gate.py (the meshuris1 stuck-stamp trace fails by name within the grace; the meshuris0 valid-stamp trace passes with the gate silent; key off is byte-identical; the grace is sim-clock not wall-clock) -- run with PYTEST_DISABLE_PLUGIN_AUTOLOAD=1 PYTHONPATH=. python3 -m pytest scripts/twin/tests/test_sim_robust_esdf_boot_gate.py
